name: Payoneer
notes: Payoneer's dashboard API gives no plain-text description: `Description` is a translation key (ResKey) plus parameters, so the source maps the parameter that names the other party (payer, bank, merchant) and leaves fees (TypeId 24) with none. TypeId seen: 15 incoming payment, 6 payment received (older), 1 withdrawal to bank, 24 fee, 2 outgoing payment, 10 bank-verification deposit, 13 credit. `Date` is the dashboard's local time with no zone; verified against Payoneer's UTC CSV as US Eastern with daylight saving (5 h behind UTC in November, 4 h in August), so the source declares timeZone America/New_York and records carry dateTime with the offset. A withdrawal's amount already includes its fee; the fee is only in the per-item detail (getItemDetailsRawData → activityMainData.Fee), so feeSplit fetches it for each withdrawal and delivers the net transfer plus the fee as a separate movement (`<id>|fee`). Balances come from the monthly-statement picker (currency balances and the USD card balance); a closed old balance that no longer appears there is not listed.
